b_model_discovery.description: Per-cell-type linear mixed model.  Response Y is arcsin(sqrt(fraction)) — arcsin-square-root is preferred over logit for fractions because the deconvolution output has many exact zeros in low-infiltration glioma samples; logit(0) = -Inf forces a pseudo-count that can distort the interaction coefficient.
b_model_discovery.formula_r_style: arcsin_sqrt_fraction ~ timepoint * treatment_arm   + estimate_purity   + who_grade_initial   + age_at_diagnosis   + codeletion_1p19q   + mgmt_methylation   + (1 | patient_id)
b_model_discovery.treatment_definition: BINARY — Any_RT (n=20) vs No_RT (n=13), exactly per §4.3 lock below.
b_model_discovery.notes: Do NOT add chemo as a within-arm covariate: RT-only n=3 cannot support that estimate (plan §4.3 hard rule).

b_model_glass.description: Mirror of discovery formula; treatment can be four-level (untreated / TMZ_only / RT_only / RT_TMZ) if per-arm n > 3 after IDH filter.
b_model_glass.formula_r_style: arcsin_sqrt_fraction ~ timepoint * treatment_arm   + estimate_purity   + who_grade_initial   + age_at_diagnosis   + codeletion_1p19q   + mgmt_methylation   + (1 | patient_id)
b_model_glass.treatment_definition_fallback: If four-level per-cell n collapses below 3 in any arm, fall back to binary Any_RT/No_RT discovery definition.

c_multiple_testing.rejection_threshold_convention: q-value < 0.05 per cell type within the primary family.
c_multiple_testing.exploratory_policy: CELL_TYPES_EXPLORATORY are a separate family.  Never merge them into the primary BH-FDR pass; report raw p + 'EXPLORATORY' label.
robustness_checks: Bonferroni-adjusted p (0.05 / 10 = 0.005) reported alongside BH q as a sensitivity row.

d_permutation.units_shuffled: patient-level treatment labels (timepoints stay paired within patient).
d_permutation.how: For each of 10000 iterations, sample an independent permutation of the length-N_patients treatment vector WITHOUT stratification (no block preservation by subtype — conservative; subtype IS a covariate in the model so residual subtype-balance-drift is already modelled). Fit the exact same LMM formula each time, extract the interaction coefficient, build the two-tailed empirical CDF, compute empirical p = (1 + count(|perm_coef| >= |observed_coef|)) / (1 + n_perm).
d_permutation.reporting: For every primary cell type, four p-values appear side-by-side: (1) asymptotic LMM p, (2) LMM Satterthwaite-KE df adjusted p, (3) permutation-based empirical p, (4) BH-FDR q derived from (3). Primary claim uses (4); (1) and (2) shown for reviewers who ask.
d_permutation.parallelism: Use joblib loky backend, n_jobs = min(cpu_count, 8).

T_cell_exhaustion.test: At RECURRENT timepoint, Any_RT vs No_RT DESeq2/limma contrast restricted to CD8+ deconvolution-pseudo-bulk (or snRNA CD8+ cluster if available).

T_regulatory_suppression.test: Same recurrent-only Any_RT vs No_RT design.

Myeloid_polarization_M1_M2.test: Module score (AddModuleScore in Seurat) per sample, Any_RT vs No_RT at recurrent timepoint, Mann–Whitney U.

allowed_databases: ImmuneSigDB C7 (immunologic signatures) — restricted to sub-collections with keywords: glioma, lymphocyte, tcell, exhaustion, myeloid, radiotherapy.
GSEA_restriction.forbidden: Never run the full MSigDB C2/C5/C7 unrestricted.  Never use KEGG as a primary pathway layer (too coarse).

f_treatment_lock.excluded_note: Patient IDs in this block are to be filled from Johnson et al. Nature 2026 Supplementary Table 1 column 'treatment_between_timepoints' = 'Not Reported' / NA.  The acquire_clinical_metadata.py script reads Supp Table 1 directly and cross-checks these counts.
f_treatment_lock.rule_never_break: RT-only subgroup (n=3) must NEVER be reported as a standalone inferential test in the primary section.  Descriptive proportions only; any RT-only contrast goes to Appendix labelled 'n-too-small — descriptive only, no p-value reported'.

g_forest_plot.error_bars: 95% profile-likelihood CI for the interaction term; if profile-likelihood fails → 95% Wald CI with explicit footnote.
g_forest_plot.diamond: Fixed-effects meta-analytic pooled estimate across the two cohorts ONLY if I² heterogeneity p > 0.10 (i.e. homogeneous).  If heterogeneous, draw separate circles + no pooled diamond.
g_forest_plot.annotation: Every row carries BH-FDR q-value from the discovery-cohort permutation test.
